recommendations.name: DRS-OSS (drs-llm)
recommendations.description: The closest open-source match to Meta's DRS: a fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B diff risk classifier with an API, web UI and GitHub App that labels pull requests with a risk score.

recommendations.name: DRS-OSS replication package (jit-dp-llm)
recommendations.description: The fine-tuning scripts and deployment artifacts behind DRS-OSS, useful if you want to train or tune the model on your own repository's history.

recommendations.name: JITLine
recommendations.description: A lightweight, fast just-in-time defect predictor that flags risky commits and lines, available as a Zenodo replication package (I did not find an official GitHub repo and did not check its maintenance).
